Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class DexpiPlantItems

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.DexpiPlantItems
public final class DexpiPlantItems extends Object
Locates plant items (Equipment and PipingComponent) in a Proteus / DEXPI XML document.

Two layouts are supported:

  • Standard Proteus form (DEXPI 1.3/1.4, DexpiXmlWriter output, the DEXPI reference examples): the <Equipment> or <PipingComponent> element is the plant item itself and carries its own ComponentClass. Its children (Nozzle, Label, GenericAttributes, Position, ...) are not plant items. Nested elements of the same tag that carry a ComponentClass (for example Chamber, Impeller or TubeBundle inside a pump or heat exchanger) are sub-equipment of the enclosing item and are not returned as separate items.
  • Wrapper form: the <Equipment> or <PipingComponent> element has no ComponentClass and each child element is a plant item, for example <Equipment><CentrifugalPump ComponentClass="..."/> </Equipment>.

Elements inside a ShapeCatalogue are symbol definitions, not plant items, and are always ignored.

  • Method Details

    • findCandidates

      public static List<Element> findCandidates(Document document, String tagName)
      Returns the candidate plant-item elements for the given tag in document order.

      In the standard form the returned element is the Equipment/PipingComponent element itself. In the wrapper form the returned elements are the children of the wrapper; such children may lack a ComponentClass, so callers decide how to report them.

      Parameters:
      document - the parsed DEXPI document
      tagName - "Equipment" or "PipingComponent"
      Returns:
      candidate plant-item elements, never null
